title: A conserved basic motif mediates membrane anchoring and TRAF2 recruitment across costimulatory TNFRs.
authors: Zhu, Jiali; Xu, Xi; Liu, Pei; Wu, Hui; Wang, Yuxuan; Xu, Boying; Wen, Maorong; Chen, Min; Chen, Zhifeng; Chou, James J; Zhao, Linlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TNFR共刺激受体的膜锚定与TRAF2招募机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Costimulatory receptors of the TNFR superfamily are key components in synthetic immunoreceptors, yet how their intracellular domains coordinate membrane anchoring with adaptor recruitment remains unresolved. Here, using solution-state NMR and membrane-reconstituted FRET assays, we identify a conserved basic-residue-rich sequence (BRS) in the juxtamembrane region of OX40 that binds anionic phospholipids and adopts a membrane-inserted conformation. This membrane engagement enables a dual-site interaction with TRAF2, combining canonical PxQxx binding with a secondary membrane-proximal interface, to promote robust NF-kappaB activation. Disruption of the BRS impairs adaptor docking without reducing receptor surface expression or ligand-induced clustering. This regulatory architecture is further supported in 4-1BB and CD40, indicating broader relevance across TNFR costimulatory receptors. Our findings refine current models of TNFR signaling and offer a generalizable framework for receptor design. Incorporating membrane-anchoring motifs into synthetic constructs may enhance spatial control of adaptor recruitment, thereby improving signal fidelity, sensitivity, and performance in CAR-T applications.
abstract_zh: TNFR超家族的共刺激受体是合成免疫受体的关键组成部分，然而其胞内结构域如何协调膜锚定与适配器招募仍不清楚。在此，我们利用溶液态核磁共振（solution-state NMR）和膜重构FRET实验，鉴定了OX40近膜区域中一个保守的富含碱性残基序列（BRS），该序列结合阴离子磷脂并采用膜插入构象。这种膜结合使得与TRAF2的双位点相互作用成为可能，结合经典PxQxx结合与一个次级近膜界面，以促进强效的NF-kappaB激活。破坏BRS会损害适配器对接，而不降低受体表面表达或配体诱导的聚集。这一调控架构在4-1BB和CD40中也得到进一步支持，表明其在TNFR共刺激受体中具有更广泛的适用性。我们的发现完善了当前TNFR信号传导模型，并为受体设计提供了通用框架。将膜锚定基序纳入合成构建体可能增强适配器招募的空间控制，从而改善CAR-T应用中的信号保真度、敏感性和性能。
